permissions.noRestore: Restoring a backup requires the backups.restore permission, which this role doesn't have.
permissions.noDownload: Downloading a backup requires the backups.download permission, which this role doesn't have.

pageHeader.title: World Backups
pageHeader.description: Create, restore, and manage your server world backups
pageHeader.remoteDisabledTitle: Backups are not available for remote servers
pageHeader.uploadTitleRemote: Backups are not available for remote servers

alerts.remoteDesc: The active server is configured as remote, so the panel can't reach its filesystem. Create, upload, and restore are unavailable until you switch to a local server.

statusCards.deferredForRestart: Due since {{time}} — waiting for the server restart to finish
statusCards.lastScheduledSkippedForRestart: Last scheduled backup skipped for a restart ({{time}})

scheduledAttempt.restartStuck: Not run: the server restart had been running for {{minutes}} min ({{warningMinutes}}-minute warning) without finishing — far longer than a restart takes, so it looked stuck, and manual backups were blocked while it lasted. If a restart still seems to be running, check whether the game server came back up, then restart the panel to clear it. Creating a backup after that also clears the failed-backup warning.
scheduledAttempt.restartStuckSinceDue: Not run: the server restart running when this backup came due still hadn't finished {{minutes}} min later — far longer than a restart takes, so it looked stuck, and manual backups were blocked while it lasted. If a restart still seems to be running, check whether the game server came back up, then restart the panel to clear it. Creating a backup after that also clears the failed-backup warning.

settingsPanel.title: Schedule & retention
settingsPanel.description: When this world is backed up on its own, and how many backups are kept.
settingsPanel.enabledHelp: Runs on the schedule below; past the limit, the oldest backups are deleted.
settingsPanel.frequencyHelp: How often to automatically create backups
settingsPanel.maxBackupsHelp: Oldest backups will be auto-deleted when limit is reached
settingsPanel.includeDbHelp: Adds a copy of the panel database (servers, settings, schedules, accounts) to every backup, with passwords, sessions and other secrets left out. Restoring a backup never applies it.
settingsPanel.onlyWhenOnlineLabel: Only back up while the server is running
settingsPanel.onlyWhenOnlineHelp: Scheduled backups skip a server that is stopped: its world can't change while it's down. When the panel can't tell, it backs up anyway. Manual backups are not affected.
settingsPanel.scheduledServersHelp: Each checked server is backed up in turn, into its own backups folder. Until you choose, the schedule backs up the active server alone.
settingsPanel.scheduledServersNone: No server is checked, so the schedule backs up nothing.
settingsPanel.maxBackupsInvalid: Enter how many backups to keep, from 1 to 100.
settingsPanel.customHint: Format: minute hour day month weekday. "{{example}}" runs every day at 3:30. At most once every 5 minutes.
settingsPanel.timezoneNotice: Schedule times are in the panel's timezone, {{tz}} (change it in Scheduler).
settingsPanel.scheduledBackupsOff: Scheduled backups are off — this schedule takes effect once you turn them on.
settingsPanel.bothDayFieldsNote: Day of month and weekday must both match: backups run only on days that satisfy both, not either one.

restartOverlap.title: Backups overlap a scheduled restart
restartOverlap.task: Some scheduled backups land inside the scheduled restart "{{name}}" (for example, the {{backupTime}} backup, during the {{restartTime}} restart).
restartOverlap.taskAll: Every scheduled backup lands inside the scheduled restart "{{name}}" (for example, the {{backupTime}} backup, during the {{restartTime}} restart).
restartOverlap.taskUnnamed: Some scheduled backups land inside a scheduled restart (for example, the {{backupTime}} backup, during the {{restartTime}} restart).
restartOverlap.taskUnnamedAll: Every scheduled backup lands inside a scheduled restart (for example, the {{backupTime}} backup, during the {{restartTime}} restart).
restartOverlap.autoRestart: Some scheduled backups land inside the periodic auto-restart (for example, the {{backupTime}} backup, during the {{restartTime}} restart).
restartOverlap.autoRestartAll: Every scheduled backup lands inside the periodic auto-restart (for example, the {{backupTime}} backup, during the {{restartTime}} restart).
restartOverlap.consequence: Those backups wait for the restart to finish, so they run up to about {{minutes}} min late. To keep them on time, schedule backups at least {{minutes}} min after a restart's scheduled time (for example, with restarts on the hour, back up at {{exampleTime}}).
restartOverlap.consequenceNoExample: Those backups wait for the restart to finish, so they run up to about {{minutes}} min late. To keep them on time, schedule backups at least {{minutes}} min after a restart's scheduled time.

restoreProgress.title: Restoring {{name}}…
restoreProgress.titleUnknown: A restore is already in progress for this server…
restoreProgress.note: This can take a few minutes depending on world size. You can leave this page and come back — just don't stop or restart the panel until it's done.
restoreProgress.responseLost: The panel didn't answer this request. The restore runs on the panel itself, so it may still be going. Checking with the panel for the result…

restoreResult.successDetail: Took {{seconds}}s. The world it replaced was backed up first — that safety backup is the newest one in the list below. Start the server when you're ready.
restoreResult.successDetailNoSafetyBackup: Took {{seconds}}s. It was started without a safety backup, so the world it replaced wasn't kept. Start the server when you're ready.
restoreResult.notStartedProxy: A proxy or tunnel in front of the panel refused the request (HTTP {{status}}). The panel has no record of this restore, so it didn't start.
restoreResult.failedNextStep: Unless the reason above says otherwise, the current world was left as it was. Fix the cause, then try again.
restoreResult.unknownTitle: Couldn't confirm how the restore ended
restoreResult.unknownDetail: The page couldn't get this restore's result from the panel (the connection was down too long, or the panel restarted), so it may not have finished, or even started. Before you start the server, open Diagnostics › Activity and search for "restore". A backup_restored entry for this backup since you started the restore means it finished; a restore_failed entry since then says why it failed. If there's neither, restore again. If you can't open Diagnostics, ask an administrator.

mainCard.title: Backup Files
mainCard.noSavesFolderDesc: The panel couldn't find a Saves/Multiplayer folder for the active server. Set up a server if you haven't yet, or start it at least once — the folder is created on first launch.
mainCard.emptyDesc: Create a backup now, or turn on scheduled backups above, before changing saves, mods, or server settings — one bad update away from lost progress.
mainCard.emptyDescScheduled: Scheduled backups are on — the first one will appear here once it runs. Create one now instead of waiting, before changing saves, mods, or server settings.

restoreDialog.title: Restore Backup
restoreDialog.description: Restore <1>{{name}}</1> onto <3>{{serverName}}</3>. This will <2>replace</2> the current world data.
restoreDialog.bulletSafetyBackup: The panel will create a safety backup before restoring.
restoreDialog.bulletUndoRequiresRestore: Undoing this later means restoring that safety backup yourself — it won't happen automatically.
restoreDialog.scopeTip: Restoring only replaces this world's save files — your server settings, mods, and workshop items are untouched.

deleteDialog.descSingle: Delete <1>{{name}}</1>? This permanently removes the backup file.
deleteDialog.descPlural: Delete <1>{{count}} backups</1>? This permanently removes those files.

deleteOlderDialog.title: Delete Old Backups
deleteOlderDialog.description: Delete every backup older than the number of days you choose here.
deleteOlderDialog.warningWithDays: This permanently deletes backups created more than {{days}} days ago.
